hooks.command: node -e "console.log('Run /resume-context to rebuild state from the status pointer + git log. Do not rely on old conversation state.')"

node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');try{const s=execSync('git status --porcelain',{encoding:'utf8'}).split('\n').filter(Boolean);if(s.length)console.log(s.length+' uncommitted change(s). Run /checkpoint (verify + update the status pointer + local commit) before your next session so state is not lost.');}catch(e){}"

node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d||'{}');const t=j.turn_count||0;if(t>=80&&t%20===0){console.log('Session hygiene: ~'+t+' turns. A long window re-reads its growing context every turn, and that cache-read tends to dominate token cost. At a unit boundary run /checkpoint then /clear; mid-unit run /compact. Splitting is quality-neutral - same agents, same review depth.');}}catch(e){}});"
